description: Gold labels for extract-quality calibration (Platt logistic + inductive conformal bands). extract_correct=true when corpus harness match has correct modality and pattern_hint. hooks.assess / hooks.assist reserved for later assess/assist gold. Grow with the 50-submissions pack; do not treat heuristic confidence_score alone as a probability.
